Items: a yogurt cup (Brossard-type peach yogurt, ~150 g, ~150 kcal), an English muffin sandwich with ham (muffin ~60 g plus ham ~30 g, ~170 kcal), and a glass of chocolate milk (~250 ml, ~210 kcal).

After eating, the yogurt is finished, the glass is empty, and the plate holds only foil and crumbs, so everything was eaten.

Totals: kcal ≈ 150 + 170 + 210 = 530. Mass ≈ 150 + 90 + 250 = 490 g.
